comment: Battle start conditions the extractor cannot derive unambiguously (tools/extract_decomp.py extract_trainers).
Keys are TRAINER_* constants (generated/trainers.txt); values are none | rain | hail | sandstorm | sun | fog.
Only trainers whose maps give more than one condition belong here; an entry may not contradict an unambiguous derivation.

Every entry below stands on a map with date-dependent weather: include/data/map_headers.h gives the map a yearly weather (OVERWORLD_WEATHER_YEARLY_START + n, include/constants/overworld_weather.h), which FieldSystem_GetWeather looks up by date in sYearlyWeather (src/field_overworld_weather.c). Each entry takes the condition that holds on most days; the exceptions are listed here.
Route 212 South (MAP_HEADER_ROUTE_212_SOUTH, column OVERWORLD_WEATHER_ROUTE_212_SOUTH): RAINING/HEAVY_RAIN/THUNDERSTORM -> rain on 365 of 366 days; Apr 30 is CLOUDY -> none. Entries: rain.

Route 213 (MAP_HEADER_ROUTE_213, column OVERWORLD_WEATHER_ROUTE_213): CLEAR/CLOUDY -> none on 356 of 366 days; RAINING -> rain on Jan 24, Mar 13, May 11, Jul 11, Aug 9, Aug 20, Oct 18, Nov 10, Dec 2 and Dec 31. Entries: none.
Rematches (_REMATCH_n) are fought on the base trainer's map (gVsSeekerRematchData, src/overlay005/vs_seeker.c).
